plugins.name: blast-guard
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands for a yes/no with a dry-run report, blocks Python heredocs with backslash escapes, caps concurrent subagents at 4.

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Prompt-cache hit rate, context size and TTL in the status line; prices every cache rebuild; /cache-tax summary.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: plan progress from Claude's todo/task list, live turn stats, and a stall alarm after two failed attempts at the same thing.
